purpose: Determine whether run-to-run nondeterminism remains when all lab fusion, Q8 handoff, reorder, and collective feature doors are disabled on one B70.
reference_profile: Explicitly sets every GGML_META_FUSE_*, GGML_SYCL_COMM_*, GGML_SYCL_FUSED_*, GGML_SYCL_FUSE_EXT, GGML_SYCL_MMQ_Q4K_REORDER, and GGML_SYCL_QDEDUP_STATS door used by the tuned launcher to zero; unsets forced Q4_K/Q6_K reorder variables.
pilot_policy: Generate a non-publishable reference-profile 16-row token-ID oracle only if completion, zero-cache, isolation, collision, WDC-negative, kernel, and cleanup gates pass.
next_gate: Freeze the oracle, then require a fresh reference-profile replay to match 16/16 before bisecting tuned features back in.

interpretation.reference_replay_passes: At least one disabled lab feature door causes nondeterminism; bisect feature groups.
interpretation.reference_replay_fails: The defect remains in the base/shared SYCL path or another uncontrolled runtime source.
